title: ServerTasks
description: A plugin for Paper 1.21 that automates tasks like restarts, broadcasts, and custom commands with timeline notifications.
body:
ServerTasksPlus is a versatile automation plugin for Paper 1.21.x servers that allows server administrators to schedule and manage repetitive server tasks with ease.

🛠 Key Features

Scheduled Restarts
Automatically restart your server at fixed intervals (e.g. every 6 hours) with configurable warning messages before and after the restart event.

Automatic Broadcasts
Periodically broadcast server messages at configurable intervals. You can use sequential or random ordering of messages.

Custom Tasks / Commands
Create custom tasks (e.g. reward players, clear dropped items, start events) that run console commands at fixed intervals. Use per-player placeholders like %player% in commands.

Timeline Messaging
For each task, define “before” and “after” timeline points (in seconds) at which messages are broadcast to give warnings and feedback at precise moments.

Live Reload Command
Use /servertasksplus reload (with tab completion) to reload the configuration and restart all tasks without needing to fully reboot the plugin or server.

✅ Why Use It?

Helps reduce manual maintenance by automating repetitive server actions.

Enhances user experience by warning players before major events (like restarts or clears).

Flexible configuration allows adapting to your server’s schedule, tasks, and commands.

Lightweight and compatible with Paper 1.21 to 1.21.10 servers.
